items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the floods, search teams have recovered 734 bodies and rescued more than 8,000 people. About 2,500 remain unaccounted for, including over 400 foreign nationals.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on August 26, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while about 2400 people are still missing. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with teams continuing the search in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on August 26, killing many people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, with 511 people from 33 countries still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port after it hit Wednesday morning. Three people have been killed and 558 remain missing, while tents, food, and other supplies have reached the area.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 359 bodies have been recovered and 596 people from 33 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals missing or affected by the Rasuwa floods. Families can reach them on +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 from 7am to 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has set up a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Contact numbers and WhatsApp lines for the room and the Indian embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing are listed for anyone who needs them.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal this morning, killing people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the floods in Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Families can reach the Delhi control room at +91-11-23088718 or +91-11-23088719, or message +91-9968291988 or +977-9851316807.
